text.a1: A text is tiny. But what about a photo?
text.b1: Send it as one big block, and it holds the whole line.
text.b3: One glitch, and it starts all over again.
text.c1: So the internet never sends it whole.
text.d1: It cuts the photo into about two thousand small packets,
text.d2: each with her address and a number.
text.d3: They share the lines with everyone else.
text.d4: Busy road? Some go another way.
text.d5: One lost? Only that one is sent again.
text.d6: And her phone puts them back in order.
text.z1: So how does a photo cross an ocean? That's part two.
